purpose: Original synthetic teaching comparisons; inspect images and applicability before choosing a new-data treatment. These intentionally flawed comparisons are not a skill-effectiveness evaluation.

applies_when: One measured quantity across a few x-labeled treatments
An adopted mean and sample-SD definition with all raw units
cards.caption: replicate-neutral-compact/caption.md
cards.mechanism: Compact open summaries leave definite intervals and raw observations visible; x positions decode the single quantity.
cards.avoid: Broad filled summaries dominate the sparse replicate layer; choosing a bar width is a geometry decision as well as a hue decision.
source_anchors: PROGENy Fig.2d PDF p4: neutral single-series bars
scWAT Fig.3j PDF p5: bounded open bars and raw marks
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 60 × 62 mm; declared data region: 43.80 × 47.12 mm from the fixed margins.
Four categorical summaries use bar width 0.36 category-spacing units, leaving room for intervals and raw marks.

applies_when: A few categorical distributions with raw observations
The median and interval are central to the reading task
cards.caption: distribution-summary-lane/caption.md
cards.mechanism: Adjacent category-associated raw lanes keep box/median/whisker boundaries uninterrupted; area color and graphite strokes have different roles.
cards.avoid: Centering the raw layer on the summary creates competing dots, median and whisker strokes; broad summaries add mass.
source_anchors: PROGENy Fig.4c PDF p6: neutral boundaries and colored summary/body areas
Separate raw lanes are an EasyViz adaptation, not a source statistical method
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 66 × 68 mm; declared data region: 48.18 × 51.68 mm from the fixed margins.
Three category centers use box width 0.24 category-spacing units. Raw lanes are shifted by 0.28 category-spacing units, with a maximum packing spread of 2.8 mm around each shifted anchor.

applies_when: A distribution-shape question where KDE is scientifically adopted
Inner quartiles must remain distinguishable from estimated density
cards.caption: violin-summary-hierarchy/caption.md
cards.mechanism: A subordinate white KDE body and fine contour frame a stronger colored quartile area; raw points occupy an associated side lane.
cards.avoid: Equally strong colored density boundary, tinted body and central raw layer compete with the quartile summary.
source_anchors: PROGENy Fig.4c PDF p6: separate contour, inner summaries and area roles
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 66 × 68 mm; declared data region: 48.18 × 51.68 mm from the fixed margins.

Three category centers use violin width 0.24 and inner-box width 0.16 category-spacing units. Raw lanes are shifted by 0.28 category-spacing units, with a maximum packing spread of 2.8 mm around each shifted anchor.

applies_when: A matrix with many more rows than columns
Linear magnitude lookup with adopted fixed numeric bounds
cards.caption: heatmap-tall-narrow/caption.md
cards.mechanism: Matrix shape and labels set data-region geometry; visible subordinate seams separate large cells without changing the scale.
cards.avoid: Stretching a three-column matrix into wide ribbons weakens local reading; disappearing cell seams make nearby pale values merge.
source_anchors: scWAT Fig.2b PDF p4: compact narrow matrix
The blue ramp and seams are declared EasyViz adaptations
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 88 × 88 mm; declared data region: 28.16 × 67.76 mm from the fixed margins.
The fixed margins allocate a tall, narrow data region to twelve rows and three columns; automatic cell aspect follows that region. A vertical colorbar uses the space reserved on the right.

applies_when: Two classes mixed in the same fixed-size point field
Group identity must be decoded from small marks
cards.caption: scatter-small-mark-color/caption.md
cards.mechanism: Small categorical points need visible whole-panel distinction; pale bounded-area colors need not work on tiny borderless marks.
cards.avoid: Pale low-contrast colors fail as small marks on white even though they can be eligible for larger bounded areas.
source_anchors: scWAT Fig.2g PDF p4: blue/pink fitted-line colors adapted here to raw-class marks
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 75 × 70 mm; declared data region: 54.75 × 44.80 mm from the fixed margins.
Two classes share the same coordinate field and mark area; the upper margin reserves space for the two-key categorical legend.
